entities.name: Kreig
entities.description: The most powerful Keldon of all time, product of Gatha's Bloodline Project with Keldon and Phyrexian stock.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Creator of the Bloodline Project and slow-time water who spliced Keldon and Phyrexian stock.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Gatha's genetic splicing program that produced Kreig.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: Phyrexian Inner Circle member who fought Kreig.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: Phyrexian who with Croag attacked Keld's troops.

entities.name: Askaranton
entities.description: Target of a Keldon raid led by Kreig.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: Site whose cliffside Kreig and Gatha leapt from.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Enemies whose agents noticed Kreig's Phyrexian genetics.

events.summary: Kreig is born as part of Gatha's Bloodline Project.
events.quote: Kreig was born as part of Gatha 's own Bloodline Project

events.summary: On a raid on Askaranton, Phyrexian sleeper agents notice Kreig's Phyrexian genetics and Croag and Davvol begin attacking Keld's troops.
events.quote: Croag and Davvol began staging attacks on Keld's troops

events.summary: In his final battle Kreig wounds Croag but cannot defeat him.
events.quote: Kreig did manage to wound Croag, but could not defeat him.

events.summary: Kreig and Gatha jump from the Keldon Necropolis cliffside, killing themselves to avoid capture by the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Kreig and Gatha jumped off the Keldon Necropolis 's cliffside
